title: x chef defrosting tray 2 in 1
text: x chef defrosting tray 2 in 1. I apparently misread the ad - it's 2 in 1 - NOT two trays.  Eh.  I am disappointed in that.  But I did purchase this as gift in our family Christmas bingo gift pile.  I will update my review should new info seem useful after someone chooses and uses it.

product_metadata.title: X-Chef Defrosting Tray, 2 in 1 Meat Thawing Cutting Board, Fast Thawing Plate and Chopping Board for Kitchen Frozen Food, 2 Side Use Meat Defroster, Large, 15.9x9.5inch, Black
features: PACKAGE INCLUDE - 2 in 1 defrosting trays in different textures that can let you distinguish which cutting board is used for meat and which one is used for vegetables, clean and hygienic. A set of dual purpose.

MATERIAL - Both sides of thawing tray for frozen meat with hang hook is made of food grade material (PP and non-stick aluminium) for a safe food contact. Aluminium has thermal conductivity and speeds food thaw.
SIZE - The size of defrosting plate is 15.9*9.4 in. The large and flat surface of the black cutting board enables you to thaw multiple items together such as breast, bacon, chicken etc.

Quick Thaw with Natural Heat - The defrosting master tray can save you nearly half the time for food to thaw naturally, which also retains the original taste and nutrition of your food. The defroster tray is wonder and magic!

DESIGN - There is a recessed groove around the thawing plate, the juice groove on the chopping side and the full silicone border of the thawing surface can prevent dripping or melting water from leaking to your table. The 2-in-1 stacking design of the meat defroster saves storage space in the kitchen. Defrosting board without stick coated that is easier to remove food from the surface and easy to clean.

details.Material: Food grade PP, TPR, Aluminum alloy
